title: Congress Will Continue Agitation Until CEC Gyanesh Kumar Is Removed, Says KC Venugopal

ai.summary: Congress and trade unions have campaigned for the repeal of the VB-G RAM G Act, which replaced MGNREGA in December 2025, as the old law was set to end on 1 July 2026.

facts.claim: Congress and trade unions campaigned for the repeal of the VB-G RAM G Act
facts.quote: Congress and trade unions campaigned for its repeal; the old law was set to end on 1 July 2026.

ai.background_note: The VB-G RAM G Act replaced MGNREGA in December 2025, with the old law set to expire on 1 July 2026.
